identification: Oval framed watercolour (with gouache highlights) head-and-shoulders portrait of a bobbed, finger-waved 1920s woman with pearl necklace and a pale orchid corsage, signed 'Verna Edson' lower right. Oval dark timber frame with convex glass, 29 x 20 cm per catalogue. Backboard is recycled printed architectural/joinery drawing (front elevation of a chest of drawers) with illegible pencil name on it. Artist Verna Edson could not be identified online; looks like an amateur or commercial-style illustration.
